apiBehaviour: Recursive model file listing can be silently capped; fall back to scoped directory walks. A capped shallow directory is incomplete and cannot produce a trusted inventory.
legacyAuth: Per-request Bearer plus m_session_id cookie; credentials never persisted in inventories. Real restricted-account access remains unverified.

smartHttpProbe.implementationStatus: Observed only. Production bounded packet parser and revision resolver still to implement.
smartHttpProbe.finding: A Git-compatible request returns full refs directly over ModelScope HTTPS without an installed git executable. Earlier generic-client 421 must not be treated as a permanent endpoint limitation.
